name: Pyromancer: Magma Guardian adds 50% to Skin spells (#3102)
contract: #3102: Magma Guardian 706872 is a family 30 passive, e1 ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) misc 8 = SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS, BasePoints 49 = +50%, class mask C 0x4000000, which selects the Skin spells (SpellFamilyFlags C 0x4000000): Magma Skin 680387 and Ember Skin 504707 among them. SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue (SpellInfo.cpp:520) reaches Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers (Unit.cpp:12147) and Player::ApplySpellMod(SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS). Values from the DBC: Magma Skin effect index 0 (aura 182) BasePoints 199 = 200 becomes 300; Ember Skin effect index 2 (aura 220) BasePoints 9 = 10 becomes 15. Asserts spell_effect_value before and after learning the passive and after unlearning it. Effect indices here are 0-based (the group report's e1 is index 0).

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Magma Skin effect 0 is 200 without Magma Guardian
Ember Skin effect 2 is 10 without Magma Guardian
Magma Skin effect 0 is 300 with Magma Guardian
Ember Skin effect 2 is 15 with Magma Guardian
